scope: local x86_64 CPU in-process simulation with cpp_native planner; no ROS DDS, ARM64 board, NPU or vehicle
changes: adaptive Hybrid A* planning margin: primary reserve, 0.08m, then execution guard 0.06m; every path is rechecked against the execution guard
wall-return rejection margin raised from 0.06m to 0.20m to remove perimeter artifacts from the planning map
standard motion preset corner speed 0.25 -> 0.22 m/s and lookahead 0.22 -> 0.16 m
short rear-clearance/swept-footprint checked reverse arc both for start-in-collision and repeated no-path states
direct-camp planning remains primary (gap waypoints are not forced as intermediate goals)
not_verified: vehicle braking, steering calibration or track completion
formal completeness on arbitrary random minefields
